_doc: Shared by the capture script (writes raw/) and scripts/screenshots/frame.mjs (writes appstore/).
Capture needs only: iphone[].id + iphone[].theme -> raw/iphone/<theme>/<id>.png at 1320x2868,
and watch[].id -> raw/watch/<id>.png at the Ultra 3 native size (422x514).
Framing fields: title (\n = manual break), subtitle, note (small closing line),
layout = phone | phone-bottom | phone-watch, watch = <watch id> to compose beside the phone,
bg = slide background (text colour is derived from its luminance), accent = rule colour.
Devices are composited into Apple's own product bezels from screenshots/frames/.
iphone[] is the numbered App Store set, in order; max 10.
extras[] uses the same schema but renders to appstore/extras/ instead: unnumbered spares,
kept out of the contact sheet unless you pass --contact-sheet=all. Promote one by moving it
into iphone[] (and dropping one of the ten).

iphone.title:
Money in.
Money out.
Two taps.

Amount, category, done —

Your money.
Your data.
Your phone.

One budget for the trip, a daily allowance,

iphone.title:
Rent asks.
Netflix doesn’t.
iphone.subtitle:

bills that change wait for your tap.

iphone.title: Who owes whom
